bootstrap_method: Nonparametric percentile bootstrap across the 50 paired seed units; attempts and turns are never resampled as independent units. For override-gap summaries, seeds with no observed override have an unavailable value and the bootstrap uses the reported metric-specific number of valid seed units; unavailable values are never replaced by zero.
eligibility_definition: baseline plus each non-base target with P(base)-P(target) <= threshold; a bias targeting the current base move is excluded.

environments.E0_NO_CONTEXT: Arm identity only; all observed state is irrelevant.
environments.E3_QUALITY: Arm identity, current MD6 state, and prior-turn running MRB1 quality.
environments.E4_MIXED: Arm identity, current MD6 state, mastery_before, and prior-turn running MRB1 quality, with weak sparse interactions.

fixed_delayed_credit_scheme: All three selected turns update only after attempt completion, each with sample_weight=1/3; total attempt weight=1.
holm_correction_scope: The five explicit reference comparisons within each environment, checkpoint, and metric family.

intervention_metric_definitions.actual_override_rate: Fraction of turns where the selected overlay changes MD6's base move.
intervention_metric_definitions.at_least_one_alternative_rate: Fraction of turns with at least two eligible arms.
intervention_metric_definitions.at_least_two_alternatives_rate: Fraction of turns with at least three eligible arms.
intervention_metric_definitions.baseline_only_rate: Fraction of turns with exactly one eligible arm.
intervention_metric_definitions.bias_arm_selection_rate: Fraction of turns selecting a non-baseline LinTS arm.
intervention_metric_definitions.override_gap: P(base)-P(selected bias target), only on actual override turns; unavailable otherwise.

oracle_definition: Canonical-order argmax hidden utility over the current threshold-specific eligible-arm set only.
paired_difference_sign_convention: metric_at_threshold_a - metric_at_threshold_b for every metric. For cumulative regret, a positive value means threshold_b has lower regret.
permutation_method: Two-sided Monte Carlo paired sign-flip test of seed-level mean differences with +1 correction.

rng_strategy.environment_and_world_streams: Original environment indices and SeedSequence logic are retained; each environment/seed hidden coefficients, MD6, mastery, MRB1, and evaluator uniforms are generated once and shared across thresholds.
rng_strategy.policy_streams: The deterministic C3 LinTS seed is identical across thresholds within an environment/seed pair. LinTS samples all five canonical arms every turn, providing common random numbers while posterior and decision trajectories may diverge.

sanity_checks.check: mastery is absent from the threshold experiment context
increasing threshold never reduces fixed-state eligible-arm count
threshold zero is a near-baseline-only control
evaluator reward has the prescribed support
delayed total turn weight per attempt equals one
current-turn MRB1 is unavailable before action selection

tradeoff_delta_definition: threshold metric minus the corresponding 0.10-reference mean.

tradeoff_ratio_definitions.regret_change_per_additional_override: delta cumulative regret / delta actual override rate
tradeoff_ratio_definitions.regret_change_per_additional_override_op: delta cumulative regret / delta at-least-one-alternative rate
tradeoff_ratio_definitions.reward_change_per_additional_override: delta mean reward / delta actual override rate
